  Currently working for TCS project under Team Lease Digital Company as a Vmware VDI Administrator.
  Worked in Axim Automation Technologies Pvt Ltd as PLC Commissioning Engineer.
  Worked for Sterling project under Hexaware Technologies Company as Technical Analyst.
  Worked in Dell PLE Tech Support as IT consultant in Sutherland Global Solutions Limited, Chennai
  Worked in NELITO as Software Implementation on COMP DDO Project (Undertaking in NIC),
  Dehradun.
  Trained in IMU for Merchant Navy and Worked in FSMHK Pvt Ltd as JETO.

   Documentation                      : MS Excel, MS Word, MS Power point
   O S                                :     W INDOWS 10/ Windows server/ Linux Server
   Tools                              : BMC Remedy, Zen desk
   Programming Language               :  C, C++ (basic proficiency) and Python (basic proficiency)

Professional Details:
   <u>Company: </u>- Team Lease Digital Company Bengaluru (Duration from Feb 2022 to till now)
                   (As a Senior Technical Analyst).
   In Walgreen Project.
            VM Servers build and rebuild and Administration of VMware Horizon 7.
            Configuring and managing virtual Infrastructure in both Wag 1 and Wag 2 datacenter.
            Managing the multiple ESXi hosts in Vcenter Server under the Vsphere.
            Working in windows and Linux images to prepare the master images & clone Image and
            taking the snapshot. (Deploying the new VM from the template and cloning Image).
            Creating and managing the floating vdi pool in Horizon console.
            Creating and managing the VDI Role group OU, AppVol’s group OU and user’s profile in
            the Active Directory manager plus.


Handling the various Incident ticket to resolve the VDI related issue in given SLA and
Working in multiple workorder request raised by end user.
Basic knowledge in Azure Virtual Desktop and Primary support to end users.
Packaging & Deploying Application in On-prem & in Azure VDI and Performing pending
jobs or task clearing in app vol server by running the regular script in cmd.
Managing the user’s profile & virtual application through Dynamic Environment Manager.
As per INC tickets attending the VDI Troubleshooting session issue with team, virtual
application missing issue in VDI desktop, problem VMs issue, VDI connectivity issue & etc.
Basic automation scripting knowledge in Power Shell.
Implementing and maintaining a PowerShell automated test script.
Creating the GPO in Active Directory and linked the GPO in various OU.
Under the CRQ we recomposed the new prepared cloned image in several VDI pools,
Performing the rolling reboot activity in weekend of every month, and performing the
vulnerability patching activity in host and validating all hosts under Vcenter server after
the CRQ performed.
Configuring and managing the Standard and Distributed switch and Share storage (vSAN).
Configuring VMkernel adapters on ESXi host to enable the VMotion, SvMotion and
managing the Fault Tolerance.
Unlock the root account of an ESXi host in Vcenter server.
Updating firmware and BIOS of an ESXi host through iLO using the iLO web GUI.
Performing the patching activity of Vcenter server and ESXi host under the Vsphere.
Manage virtual server hosted and fixing error in ESXi hosts in all Vcenter Server.
Configuring DRS and HA in VMware ESXi cluster for high availability.
Creating the Standard CRQ, Normal and Emergency CRQ as per Infra activity requirement.


<u>Company:</u> -  <u>Axim Automation Technologies, Bengaluru.</u>
<u>(</u>Duration from Dec 2019 to Dec 2020) (As a Commissioning Engineer)

A competent professional experience of 1 years in Commissioning & Process Automation. The Job details
are as follows:
        PLC Logic development and codes implementation with required Interlock and Emergency Shut down
        as per the client process requirement. (Logic development in Ladder, for Mitsubishi GX Works 3, Allen
        Bradely RS Logix 500, Siemens Step7, PCS7).
        SCADA/HMI development as per the process requirement with maximum ease for operator.
        (SCADA/HMI development in Mitsubishi GX Works 3, GT Designer 3, Indusoft Web Studio, Siemens
        WinCC, TP1200, KTP200, PCS7 and TIA Portal SQL-2014) and Configure in MX OPC Server for
        communication Between PLC and Scada and for reports generation in Sql 2014 database.
        Configuration of alarms for required events and logging for analog tag.
        Configuration of Trends for graphical reading value and analyze with another parameter.
        Configuration of Flow meter, Control valve Operations and also for Pressure transmitter, Pressure
        switch. And Configuration of PID Modbus Communication.
        Execution and Commissioning lead for Instrumentation and Automation activities.
        Maintain site software Backups, MOMs, Customer Feedbacks and Reports of Respective Sites.

<u>Company: </u>- HEXAWARE TECHNOLOGIES (Duration from Feb 2019 to Sep 2019) (As an IT Support)
Packaging & Deploying Application for On-prem.


Working on VDI Connectivity Issue and other VDI related issue.
Troubleshooting MS Teams, Outlook and other base Installed Apps in VDI Desktop.
Attending the VDI Troubleshooting session with teams and familiar in managing VDI Pools.
Working in CRQ activity on weekend of every month.
Creating the VDI Role group and Desktop pools & Preparing Pool & Disk Reports.
User Account Management using Active Directory & Good on using Smart IT & BMC Remedy
tools.

Company<u>:</u> - SUTHERLAND GLOBAL (Duration from March 2016 to Feb 2018) (As a Technical consultant)

Working as SPOC for IT related queries for one of client.
Outlook troubleshooting (Mailbox addition, creating DL adding and removing users, profile
creation through Control Panel & config-O365).
Tools Used: BMC Helix, MS Excel, MS Teams, Citrix workspace, Cisco softphone.
Help the user to fix the issue on VPN Citrix issue, Zscaler issue and assist the user on any
issue by taking the user system remotely and resolve in remotely.
Giving the access, generating and resetting the password for System Account, various tools
& applications. Installation, configuration and administration of Windows 7, 8, 10
professional client OS.
Handling taking Care for Virtual OS, Application, Outlook Configuration, VPN issue and etc, also Monitering
the Ticket and provide the solution with given SLA to user. And Deploying Technical/logistic resources for
completion of services within SLA & Taking the charge of Resolution Experts to handle the critical cases and
Following of the incidents till resolutions.
DSP: - Guiding Dell Technician for assemble and disassemble of hardware parts. Installation of Windows OS.
Doing RCA of created services.

<u>Company: </u>-  NELITO (Duration from Dec 2014 to Nov 2015) (Operation Manager)
Worked in NELITO for one years as Software Implementation in COMP DDO Project ( Client: O/o Accountant
& General office, O/o Audit and General office and Audit office of ONGC Tel Bhawan (Dehradun)
      Installation, Configuration and administration of windows 2008,22012R2 server
      Installing the software of COMP DDO and updating the latest patches.
      Managing the functions of troubleshooting and preventive maintenance in server.
      Handling Networking server to client in some area. Feeding all data detail of employees
      (general information) in COMP DDO software to generate the text file document and
      uploading the in their database.







Decleration:

          I hereby declare that the information’s furnished above are correct and complete to the best of
          my knowledge and belief.

Date:                             Sandeepam Sah
